title: Becoming a Dou Zhe Again
summary: Xun Er meets Yao Lao over Liu Xi's body and warns him not to deceive Xiao Yan, and asks him to keep the night secret. Jia Lie Bi blames the Xiao Clan for Liu Xi's death and attacks the Xiao Residence while Xiao Yan is taking the Qi Gathering Pill to become a Dou Zhe, and Jia Lie Ao finds him mid-breakthrough. Xiao Yan breaks off to save his father, while Yao Lao, who says he was once betrayed by those close to him, argues against it. Jia Lie Bi turns on his own son for the clan's sake and nearly kills Xiao Zhan and Xiao Yan. Yao Lao holds him back while Xiao Yan completes the breakthrough to Dou Zhe and kills him with Octane Blast. Yao Lao, only a soul who wants a new body, then offers a red Di Class fire scroll or the black scroll of the Flame Mantra, which evolves by devouring Heavenly Flames. Xiao Yan picks the Flame Mantra, takes first place at the Jia Nan Academy enrolment with a year's leave, says goodbye to Xun Er and his father, and leaves Wu Tan City.
events: Xun Er confronts Yao Lao and warns him not to deceive Xiao Yan.
Jia Lie Bi blames the Xiao Clan for Liu Xi's death and storms the Xiao Residence.
Xiao Yan takes the Qi Gathering Pill to condense his Dou Zhi Qi cyclone; Jia Lie Ao attacks him.
Xiao Yan and Yao Lao argue about family; Yao Lao admits he was betrayed by loved ones.
Jia Lie Bi sacrifices his son for the clan and nearly kills Xiao Zhan and Xiao Yan; Yao Lao blocks him.
Xiao Yan becomes a Dou Zhe and kills Jia Lie Bi with Octane Blast.
Yao Lao explains he is a soul and offers a Di Class fire scroll or the Flame Mantra; Xiao Yan chooses the Flame Mantra.
A month later Xiao Yan takes first place at the Jia Nan Academy enrolment, takes leave, and sets out with Yao Lao.

Academy spelled 'Jianan Academy' here; REVIEW-NOTES canonical is Jia Nan Academy.
